android.desc:
Plan, navigate, and explore outside with Gaia GPS—the trusted app for discovering hiking trails, campsites, and winter activities like skiing and snowboarding. Download the premier outdoor activity app featured in publications like the New York Times, Washington Post, and GearJunkie. Find backpacking adventures with topographic maps. Hike with detailed GPS navigation, real-time weather, color-coded steepness layers, and key waypoints like campsites, water sources, and trail access info. Find public land and local routes to map your own trail. Whether you’re looking for campsites, off-roading routes, hiking trails, backpacking opportunities, or ski tracks, discover more outdoors this winter with Gaia GPS.

Whether you’re trekking a snowy pass, backpacking deep in the backcountry, or out for a day hike, navigate it all with Gaia GPS’s powerful collection of winter maps and navigation tools for skiing and snowboarding.

Find public land trails for backpacking, off-roading, or running. Navigate with offline maps, GPS tracking, weather updates, and campsite info—all in one backcountry navigation app.

BACKPACKING OR HIKING
• Hiking is easier when utilizing the largest collection of trails and routes available on Gaia Hike, a global map built for hikers
• Plan a route with point-to-point navigation from anywhere
• Get turn-by-turn directions to any trailhead
• Backpacking from base camp all along hiking trails and back again is easy with waypoint breadcrumbs
• Distance tracker with altitude and elevation monitoring for every winter activity
• Discover new routes for trail running on public land
• National parks or scenic hiking trails – Discover new outdoor routes waiting to be explored

SKIING AND SNOWBOARDING TRAILS
• Discover ski slopes and cross-country skiing trails around you with best-in-class topographic maps
• Get ski reports for weather conditions and Nordic trails from OnTheSnow for skiing and snowboarding

EXPLORE THE WORLD LIKE A PROFESSIONAL
• GPS coordinates help explore while creating routes and tracking progress
• Share your data with clients to improve Gaia GPS
• Access the full NatGeo map collection for navigating in outdoor activities and information on trails

OFF-ROAD ACTIVITY PLANNING
• 4x4 & overlanding adventures are easy to record on Gaia GPS
• Activity tracker and route planner make trekking, hiking, and backpacking off-road trails simple
• Trails, maps, routes, and waypoints displayed on Android Auto

FISH

quotes.text:
Have you given Gaia GPS a try? I think we satisfy most of your requirements. We provide Mapbox satellite imagery, which isn't the same as Google's, but it's pretty good.

I work on the maps on that app, so of course you ought to try it for yourself rather than believing me.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trailbehind.android.gaiagps.pro
quotes.story_title: Show HN: I made an offline-ready hiking trail companion app

quotes.text:
I use Gaia GPS for my backcountry hikes which is available for iOS/Android. You can download a variety of topo maps and aerial photos ahead of time in a particular area and load them when out of cell service.

http://blog.gaiagps.com/

https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/gaia-gps-topo-maps-trails/id329127297

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trailbehind.android.gaiagps.pro&hl=en

The only issue I'm still trying to figure out when using my phone is how to disable the cell antenna with the GPS antenna still activated to conserve battery.

There is also Backcountry Navigator which has similar features but is only available for Android devices: http://backcountrynavigator.com/
